name: untitled boxing game
creator: drowningsome
redeem: Launch untitled boxing game on Roblox and wait to load into the lobby.
Click the Codes button on the left side of the screen.
Type or paste the code into the Codes box that opens.

notes:
untitled boxing game, often shortened to UBG, is a PvP fighting game made as a solo project by drowningsome. You step into the ring against other players and win using light and heavy punches, dashes, blocks, feints and a style-specific ultimate, earning Cash from fights and quests. Fighting styles are rolled with spins, and while rarer styles such as the Legendary Deimos look flashier, the developer keeps every style viable so skill decides matches.

Codes mostly give Spins, Lucky Spins, Cash and the occasional free emote, which lets you roll for new styles without buying spins. Codes arrive with new styles and updates, after events and downtime, and as like-goal rewards, and extra secret codes are posted on the developer's X account and Discord.

faq.q: Do I get free spins in untitled boxing game when the game reaches a like goal?
faq.a: Yes. The game description says every 100 likes gives 5 spins to everyone in the game.

faq.q: Where can I find the secret untitled boxing game codes?
faq.a: The game description says there are more secret codes in the game's community links. They are posted on the developer drowningsome's X account and Discord, not in the code list in the description.

faq.q: Do I need a rare style like Deimos to win fights in untitled boxing game?
faq.a: No. The developer says every fighting style is viable and rarer ones just look cooler, so spins from codes are mainly a free way to try new styles.
